results.title: Sehwag junior carries India into semifinals with match-winning 160 against UAE
results.content: Aaryavir, son of the great Virender Sehwag, allowed India to post 309 for seven, a total which was beyond the grasp of the opposition; the UAE managed 239 all out in 50 overs

results.title: Van Dyke threatens to ‘reveal shocking details’ of his arrest, incarceration in India, blames Russia
results.content: MEA declines comment, says courts still hearing case; Mr. Van Dyke was arrested in March along with six Ukrainians, who crossed from Myanmar to Mizoram after allegedly training ethnic armed groups there

results.title: Vizag CII Partnership Summit: global policymakers, corporate captains to discuss trade and technology
results.content: Strategic sessions to evaluate India-Africa, Japan, and UAE bilateral investments, along with panel discussions on global supply chains, maritime logistics, civil aviation, and climate-resilient agriculture

results.title: Pannun’s civil lawsuit: U.S. court allows Pannun to serve NSA Doval and former intelligence chief Goyal
results.content: Order issued after U.S. State Department serves notice to officials at Indian Embassy in Washington; MEA rejects charges as ‘frivolous’, calls Pannun’s case ‘fabricated and malicious’

results.title: Red Fort under tight security on first anniversary of Delhi blast
results.content: A senior police officer said security arrangements in the area had been strengthened following the blast, with the number of CCTV cameras significantly increased to ensure round-the-clock monitoring
